page_title: SAS 0-2 ATA | Sassuolo v Atalanta 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.

90+3' 0 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) and Michel Adopo gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 0:2.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Filippo Missori (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
87' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Michel Adopo (Atalanta) replaces Teun Koopmeiners.
86' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) dribbles into the box, but Juan Musso is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
85' The game has come to an end for Andrea Pinamonti. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).

83' 0 - 1 Goal! Matteo Ruggeri plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 0:1.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
82' Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
80' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
77' A substitution has been made. Gregoire Defrel goes off and Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) comes on.
77' Alessio Dionisi decides to make a substitution. Mattia Viti will be replaced by Kevin Miranda (Sassuolo).
75' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Substitution. Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) in, Davide Zappacosta out.
71' The referee blows for a cooling break.
70' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
69' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
67' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

64' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the roof of the net, but Andrea Consigli punched it onto the bar.
62' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Ademola Lookman is replaced by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) for Nedim Bajrami.
60' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

58' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sassuolo are going to take it.
55' The ball is cleared after Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' The ball crosses the sideline and it is going to be a throw-in.
50' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), whose header floated just over the bar.

49' OFF THE POST! Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
46' The game is over for Mario Pasalic (Atalanta). Ederson comes on for the second half.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a switch. Charles De Ketelaere is coming on in place of Duvan Zapata (Atalanta) at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alessio Dionisi gives a chance to Filippo Missori and Matias Vina (Sassuolo) is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Matteo Marchetti has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
44' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
42' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
37' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
35' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
31' Duvan Zapata (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Wonderful movement by Atalanta. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
27' A cooling break is underway.
24' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
23' The corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared away by the defence. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

23' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marchetti saw the whole situation.
18' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
16' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
14' Sassuolo are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
12' Rough tackle by Matias Vina (Sassuolo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

11' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marchetti with no other option than to blow for a foul.
10' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
8' An attempted cross from Matias Vina (Sassuolo) is cleared.
6' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
4' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Juan Musso (Atalanta) leaps to collect the ball.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sassuolo.
3' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
